extracted_parameters.quote: The 3D printed device was designed using SolidWorks software 2016–2017 (Dassault Systèmes SE, France) and printed by Objet Eden 260VS professional 3D printer (Stratasys, Ltd., Eden Prairie, MN, USA).

A series of 3D printed devices were designed and printed using an optically transparent build material in three different spatial orientations on the print bed with respect to the direction of the movement of the print head: parallel (angle of 0°), diagonal (45°) and perpendicular (90°).

extracted_parameters.quote: To dissolve the soluble support, 3D printed devices were soaked in water for 1–2 h, depending on the length and size of the channel, followed by soaking in 2% NaOH for up to a maximum of 12 h.
